_comment: Fields a driver emits a number for after its device stopped answering,
a number that came from no read, config or clock (0 W, 50 Hz, 0 % SoC).
This file records debt that already shipped: 44 of the 91 drivers when
drivers/tests/test_no_invented_numbers.py was added. The test ratchets:
a count that rises fails, a driver not listed must be clean, and a count
that falls fails until this file is updated. Shrink it. Never grow it.
make invented-number-report ID=<id> prints the fields for one driver.
